notes: ENO XFX - XFX MODE, long ambient drones. Every key from C1 to C7 layers three sources at once: a drone wavetable with an octave partner, a quiet FM bell-pad engine and a looped synthesized choir or pad sample, each with its own slow 1-3 second attack and 2.5-3 second release. Four flavours (wavetable-led, FM-led, choir-led, pad-led) are scattered across the keys with different unison, detune, filter and mix, so holding a chord of neighbouring keys gives a slowly shifting generative texture. Hold keys, add the sustain pedal, and let the hall reverb do the rest.
